translation: (Two cun above the navel, at the lower opening of the stomach.) It passes Jianli (CV11), (three cun above the navel) and meets Hand-Taiyang, Hand-Shaoyang, and Foot-Yangming at Zhongwan (CV12). (Four cun above the navel, the mu of the stomach.) It ascends Shangwan (CV13), (five cun above the navel) Juque (CV14), (one cun below Jiuwei, the mu of the heart) Jiuwei (CV15), (five fen below the xiphoid) Zhongting (CV16), (in the hollow one cun six fen below Danzhong) Danzhong (CV17), (one cun six fen below Yutang, directly between the two breasts) Yutang (CV18), (one cun six fen below Zigong) Zigong (CV19), (one cun six fen below Huagai) Huagai (CV20), (one cun below Xuanji) Xuanji (CV21), (one cun below Tiantu) ascends the throat, and meets Yinwei at Tiantu (CV22) and Lianquan (CV23). (Tiantu is in the hollow four cun below the Adam's apple; Lianquan is above the Adam's apple, below the tongue, in the center.) It ascends the chin, runs along Chengjiang (CV24), and meets the Hand and Foot Yangming and the Du vessel.
